questions.question: Give three reasons why people grow food in towns and cities.
questions.expected_answer: To save money on food, to have fresh and healthy food, to earn money by selling the surplus, to bring the community together, to keep farming skills alive, and to make empty spaces green.

questions.question: Name four places in a town or city where people grow food.
questions.expected_answer: Backyard gardens, community gardens, school gardens, rooftop gardens, and containers such as pots, buckets and tyres on stoeps and balconies, and keyhole gardens.

questions.question: Name two challenges of growing food in a city and how gardeners deal with them.
questions.expected_answer: Little space, solved by using containers, rooftops and small beds. Little water, solved by mulch, watering early or late and rain water tanks. Poor soil, improved with compost. Theft, prevented with fences and people watching over the garden.
